title: Wire profile React Query hooks to backend and ensure Profile Setup overlay dismisses after save

requirements.summary: Update React Query profile hooks to call backend get/save methods, keep query key ['currentUserProfile'], invalidate/refetch on save, and show an English error toast on save failure.
acceptanceCriteria: `useGetCallerUserProfile` calls the backend `getCallerUserProfile()` and returns a `UserProfile` when present, otherwise `null`.
`useSaveCallerUserProfile` calls backend `saveCallerUserProfile(...)` and no longer throws the hardcoded "Profile save method not yet implemented" error.
After a successful profile save, `['currentUserProfile']` is invalidated and refetched, and `App.tsx` stops rendering `<ProfileSetup />` (overlay disappears and the app becomes usable).
On save failure, the Profile Setup dialog remains open and a user-visible error toast is shown (in English).

file_operations.description: Replace the stubbed profile query/mutation with real actor calls to `getCallerUserProfile()` and `saveCallerUserProfile(...)` while keeping the existing query key `['currentUserProfile']`. Add minimal type/shape bridging so the hook returns `UserProfile | null` to the app (including mapping backend `id` to the local string form if needed). Ensure `enabled` correctly waits for the actor (avoid modal flash), and on successful save invalidate/refetch `['currentUserProfile']` so `App.tsx` no longer shows `<ProfileSetup />`. Add `onError` handling that shows an English error toast (using the existing Sonner toast system) without closing the dialog. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Align the submit flow with the updated `useSaveCallerUserProfile` behavior: ensure the mutation is called with the expected input shape and that save failures keep the dialog open while showing a user-visible English toast (avoid duplicating toasts if the hook now toasts on error). Keep existing English validation messages and success toast behavior.
